blurb: Nestled in the gateway to the cabot trail, BCTC provides spectacular camping and recreational opportunities. Visit the “Village of Baddeck”, the “Alexander Graham Bell Museum”, the “Gaelic College”, the historical “Fortress of Louisburg”, several Fishing , Wildlife , Bird and Whale watching Tours or perhaps a World Class 18-Hole Golf Course, “Bell Bay” is only Minutes away.
